findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 12 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 84 questions numbered 1-84; by section: 12.1 1, 12.1.1 3, 12.1.2 2, 12.1.3 2, 12.1.4 3, 12.1.5 3, 12.1.6 8, 12.2 3, 12.2.1 5, 12.2.2 4, 12.2.3 3, 12.2.4 4, 12.2.5 6, 12.2.6 6, 12.2.7 5, 12.2.8 2, 12.2.9 7, 12.3.1 3, 12.3.2 3, 12.3.3 5, 12.4 6. Keys: {'a': 21, 'b': 21, 'c': 21, 'd': 21}.

Covers every section 12.1-12.4 in book order; all limits use functions and numbers changed from the book's examples and none repeats the unit's exercises. Every key and every distractor was checked by computation (sympy, check12.py). No question relies on a printed misprint (1/n^2 values, n -> 0, lim 5 as x -> a, the dropped x in 12.2.2, log_e^a, epsilon printed as 'belongs to', the dropped square root in Example 6).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
